name: list_selection_sets
author: hprebar
title: List selection and search sets
description: Flat list of every saved selection set and search set (folders included as path segments): name, kind (search / explicit / folder), guid and folder path; optionally how many items each set currently resolves to. Read-only.

includeCounts.description: Resolve each set against the model and report its item count (slower on big models)
